patches.title: Porch downstream governance and AI disclosure
patches.reason: Identify the public Porch distribution, preserve upstream policy, and make all future divergence auditable.
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if Porch ceases to be a downstream distribution.

patches.title: Porch Stable and Canary desktop distribution identities
patches.reason: Ship independently installable Porch clients with Porch-owned origins, branding, update feeds, and release automation while preserving Fluxer runtime behavior.
tests: channel identity and default-origin smoke tests
Velopack installed-mode smoke under packaged Electron Node
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if Porch stops distributing branded desktop clients.

patches.title: Porch authenticated bootstrap recovery
patches.reason: Prevent stale runtime configuration and an unanswered gateway IDENTIFY from leaving authenticated web, PWA, or desktop clients on an indefinite splash screen.
patches.removal_condition: Remove after upstream independently ships equivalent READY timeout, stale-shell protection, and user-visible bootstrap recovery.

patches.title: Complete Porch client and package branding
patches.reason: Prevent empty runtime branding URLs and stale packaged assets from exposing Fluxer logos on Porch web, PWA, desktop, tray, installer, and Linux metadata surfaces.
tests: app TypeScript typecheck and production build
desktop product and workflow isolation validation
Stable and Canary packaged branding inspection
production Stable and Canary visual smoke
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if Porch stops distributing branded clients or upstream provides an equivalent compile-time self-host branding contract.

patches.title: Independent API CORS client origins
patches.reason: Keep Stable and Canary authorized against one backend without misusing the public marketing endpoint as a hidden CORS slot.
tests: production Stable and Canary CORS smoke
patches.removal_condition: Remove after upstream exposes an independent additional API CORS origins setting.

patches.title: Runtime Porch branding for transactional email
patches.reason: Prevent transactional email and report-system messages from leaking upstream product and contact identities.
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if upstream makes transactional email branding and contact identity fully instance-configurable.

patches.title: Complete Porch public terminology and links
patches.reason: Prevent developer documentation, OpenAPI, status/help navigation, setup defaults, runtime fallbacks, API errors, and dormant public integrations from presenting upstream Fluxer identity to Porch users.
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if every public product, contact, documentation, status, and fallback identity becomes instance-configurable upstream.

patches.title: Allow Cloudflare Turnstile through the app CSP
patches.reason: Allow the configured Turnstile client script and challenge iframe to load while preserving backend Siteverify enforcement.
tests: production Stable and Canary CSP inspection
patches.removal_condition: Remove after upstream includes Cloudflare Turnstile's required CSP origins whenever Turnstile support is enabled.

patches.title: Separate member account registration links from social invites
patches.reason: Let existing Porch members invite one new person without allowing community or group-DM links to bypass closed registration or silently grant membership.
tests: member registration invite timestamp regression test
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if Porch stops using invite-only registration or upstream independently separates member registration links from community and group-DM membership invites.

patches.title: Isolate Porch automation from Fluxer and legacy infrastructure
patches.reason: Prevent this detached fork from dispatching to or mutating Fluxer-owned systems, remove obsolete deployment and moderation workflows, and automatically publish the shared Porch API image from Canary.
tests: image fragment staging without draft GitHub releases
GitHub Actions Canary API image build
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if Porch ceases to be a detached distribution or all inherited automation becomes destination-safe, Porch-owned, and compatible with the Porch deployment model.

patches.title: Porch Hub automatic account enrollment
patches.reason: Give every eligible Porch account a shared welcome community without coupling account registration to community invites or enabling Fluxer's restrictive single-community mode.
tests: Porch Hub registration, backfill, approval, voluntary-leave, and login reconciliation API tests
Porch branding and automation isolation validation
patches.removal_condition: Remove only if Porch no longer uses a default Hub or upstream adds equivalent configurable, exactly-once enrollment with approval and backfill support.

patches.title: Keep native screen sharing active when local preview capture fails
patches.reason: The native sender and native pixel capture can start successfully even when Chromium cannot acquire the second, local-only preview track. A preview failure must not tear down a working outgoing screen share.
tests: native display capture preview-failure regression tests
screen-share option and active-source regression tests
patches.removal_condition: Remove if upstream makes native outgoing capture independent from Chromium local-preview acquisition or replaces the duplicate preview capture with a reliable native preview path.

patches.title: Ship Windows native screen capture and reuse sender frames for device previews
patches.reason: Porch's unsigned Windows workflow omitted the native capture module, which made every display and window share fail with disabled-by-launch. Device shares also opened the selected capture card twice and LiveKit silently fell back to the webcam when the second open failed. Windows builds now include native capture, native sidecar packaging honors the workflow's Cargo target directory, and local device previews consume the native sender's existing frames.
tests: native device screen-share sender-preview regression tests
native sidecar Cargo output path regression tests
patches.removal_condition: Remove if Porch stops shipping the Windows desktop client or upstream provides an unsigned-compatible native display capture build and renders local device-share previews from the active native sender.

patches.title: Source-native capture-card and ultrawide screen sharing
patches.reason: Porch needs capture-card sharing and unusual display aspect ratios without distortion. Source capture format is now separate from outgoing stream dimensions, presets use a height ceiling while preserving the actual aspect ratio, Source uses native dimensions, FPS remains selectable up to 60, the native sender scales I420 frames only when necessary, capture-mode labels always render real values, diagnostics distinguish capture-card source dimensions from encoded output dimensions, both active-call control bars identify capture-card sources as devices, and changing quality on a live native device share restarts that sender with the requested source/output pair. Windows display and window capture also falls back to copied BGRA or NV12 frames when the negotiated codec cannot consume shared D3D11 textures, preventing valid local previews from becoming all-zero green streams for remote participants.
tests: screen-share preset, Source, ultrawide, bitrate, and capture/output separation tests
native sender ultrawide output and fallback-aspect tests
Windows shared-texture rejection and BGRA/NV12 CPU-readback fallback tests
native sender copied-frame validation and publication tests
active native device-share quality replacement policy tests
active app, capture-card, and display context classification tests
voice engine v2 bridge contract tests
screen-share state, migration, picker, codec, and preview regression suite
patches.removal_condition: Remove if upstream provides equivalent source-native capture-card selection, non-distorting preset scaling, Source resolution, 60 FPS control, ultrawide rendering, adaptive quality, and native diagnostics.

patches.title: Render timestamp desktop builds as readable dates
patches.reason: Porch desktop versions are immutable timestamp identifiers such as 2026.729.135314. Updater dialogs retain that exact identifier while also explaining it as a readable UTC build date.
tests: compact and legacy timestamp formatter tests
patches.removal_condition: Remove if Porch stops using timestamp desktop versions or upstream displays them with equivalent human-readable context.

patches.title: Preserve warm caches and reduce renderer event churn
patches.reason: Porch navigation and live window resizing intermittently stalled because normal desktop starts discarded Chromium code and shader caches, self-hosted spellcheck attempted unavailable downloads before falling back, scroll components performed redundant observation and layout work, the desktop channel view observed every pixel of a resize, and failed voice-debug uploads retried and logged without backoff. The performance record also preserves the acceleration and media benchmark evidence behind the selected defaults.
tests: window observable publication and duplicate-listener regression tests
voice-debug upload classification and exponential-backoff tests
Rspack initial vendor-chunk policy test and production bundle audit
hardware acceleration on/off idle, voice, camera, display-share, and capture-card matrix
patches.removal_condition: Remove individual changes only when upstream preserves normal warm caches, avoids unavailable self-hosted dictionary downloads, and provides equivalent coalesced scroll, resize, breakpoint, and diagnostics-upload behavior without navigation or memory regressions.

patches.title: Keep native media controls synchronized with active publishing
patches.reason: Native camera and screen-share publishing update Porch's local voice state before participant snapshots necessarily converge. Control surfaces that trusted only a participant snapshot could lose their stop controls after an unrelated rerender while native capture continued in the background. Porch now merges both authoritative signals so the active controls remain available throughout snapshot convergence.
tests: local and participant media-control state merge regression tests
native capture-card share preview-hide lifecycle test
patches.removal_condition: Remove when native participant snapshots are synchronously authoritative for local camera and screen-share publication across every rerender and reconnect.

patches.title: Keep Chromium runtime-cache identity stable across launches
patches.reason: Electron exposes app.asar through a virtual filesystem whose directory timestamp changes as bundle entries are accessed. Including that metadata in Porch's runtime-cache key made every launch purge Chromium code, GPU, shader, and service-worker caches. The key now uses immutable Porch release/runtime identity plus the real installed executable fingerprint.
tests: runtime-cache identity stability and invalidation regression tests
three consecutive packaged Canary launches without repeated cache removal
patches.removal_condition: Remove when upstream provides an equivalent cache-compatibility key that remains stable across ordinary packaged launches while invalidating after runtime or installed-release changes.

patches.title: Cache hash-only Rspack assets immutably
patches.reason: Porch's Rspack output uses content-hash-only filenames, but the app proxy recognized only dotted or hyphenated hash suffixes. Immutable JS, CSS, images, and WASM therefore revalidated hourly. Porch now recognizes all three content-addressed naming forms and applies its existing one-year immutable cache policy.
tests: hash-only, dotted, hyphenated, short-hex, and unversioned cache-key classification tests
patches.removal_condition: Remove when upstream's asset-cache classifier recognizes hash-only Rspack output with an equivalent immutable policy.

patches.title: Follow operating-system media routes across startup and hot-plug changes
patches.reason: Porch desktop returned placeholder-only audio inventories before native call initialization and treated a stored default input as a no-op. Default-route changes also retained the same synthetic ID, so active input, output, camera capture, and preview state could miss the concrete endpoint change. Porch now enumerates real audio devices before a call, preserves Windows default and communications as dynamic routes, reapplies those routes when their endpoint moves, and identifies the synthetic camera route as Automatic.
tests: default, communications, physical endpoint, automatic camera, and missing-device route tests
Windows Core Audio default and communications endpoint live probe
native route annotation and WebRTC inventory mismatch regression tests
desktop IPC and bridge regression suite
Windows Sound settings and browser media inventory comparison
patches.removal_condition: Remove individual changes only when upstream enumerates native devices before calls, preserves Windows default and communications routes dynamically, refreshes active routes after endpoint changes, and exposes equivalent automatic camera semantics.
